dedupe_keys.name: building height and roof material dataset dominica pichelin and roseau 2018 2024

description: A Caribbean multi-hazard project publishes estimated building heights and roof materials for Pichelin and Roseau in Dominica. Zenodo provides a ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The described GeoPackages use 2024 Pichelin and 2018 Roseau airborne images. A monocular-depth network estimated height, and a separate image classifier assigned roof material. These layers can inform wind, hurricane and flood exposure simulations where roof type and building height affect vulnerability. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this two-town product. Coverage is the imaged areas and dates, not all of Dominica or a survey of roof condition. A limitation is that the heights and classes are model predictions, with possible errors from shadowing, image quality and transfer from training data. The page does not provide a building-by-building uncertainty table. No archive was downloaded, and neither classifier performance nor geographic alignment was independently checked.
